subject: Economic buyer & budget owner follow-up — Redwood demo recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@zenithtech.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Demo recap + next steps (stakeholder mapping)

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for taking time today — really enjoyed the conversation and getting a sense of Zenith's use cases for generative search and summarization in customer support. Quick recap from my side:

- Primary use case: reduce avg handle time by surfacing relevant KB content and generating TL;DRs for agents.
- Key success metrics: 30% reduction in handle time, 20% containment uplift, and clear latency SLAs for in-tool responses.
- Security asks you called out: SOC 2 evidence, SSO/SAML support, and data residency options.

To help us move this through procurement and sizing internally, could you confirm the economic buyer and the budget owner we should loop in? From the call it sounded like the technical champion will be Tom Becker (CTO) — is that right? Also:

- Who in Finance/Procurement owns budget sign-off (name/email)?
- Any specific procurement steps or PO/contract templates we should route to procurement@zenithtech.com?
- Timeline/board cadence for approvals (target quarter/budget cycle)?

I'll put together a one-page mutual action plan and tailored pricing options once I have the budget owner and procurement contact. I'm copying Alex Martinez (solutions engineer) to prep a short technical summary and the SOC 2 summary.

Attachments: Zenith_Redwood_Demo_Deck_v2.pdf (tailored deck) — will send along in the next email.

Thanks — talk soon,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | 415-555-0142
http://redwood.ai
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@zenithtech.com>

Subject: Re: Demo recap + next steps (stakeholder mapping)

Hi Marissa,

Great recap — thanks. Confirming stakeholder mapping from our side:

- Technical champion: Tom Becker (CTO) — tom is driving architecture and perf requirements.
- Economic buyer / budget sign-off: Clara Nguyen, VP of Finance — clara.nguyen@zenithtech.com.
- Procurement & contracting: procurement@zenithtech.com (we use a standard MSFT-style PO process; expect legal redlines around data residency and vendor indemnity).

Timeline: our FY28 budget kicks off 1 Apr; finance requires pricing + SOW by 12 Mar to consider for Q2 pilot funding. There's also a compliance review required for any vendor storing customer content — they'll want SOC 2 and a short security questionnaire answered.

Can you share: SOC 2 summary, SSO/SAML setup docs, and a high-level TCO estimate (3-6 month pilot pricing)? If you can draft a 1-2 slide summary for Clara that calls out ROI, that would help speed approvals.

Also looping in Tom (CTO) and procurement for visibility.

Thanks,
Samantha Liu
Director, Customer Experience | Zenith Technologies
samantha.liu@zenithtech.com

Hi Samantha (and team),

Thanks — that's really helpful. Next steps from Redwood:

1) Attached: Zenith_Redwood_Demo_Deck_v2.pdf and Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf — quick materials for Clara and procurement.
2) I'll draft a 1-page mutual action plan and a 3-6 month pilot pricing option (TCO + pilot success metrics) and share by EOD Wed (24 Feb).
3) Proposed intro: Clara, would you be open to a 20-min intro to cover budget process and approval timeline next week? Suggested times: Tue 2 Mar 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 3 Mar 09:00-09:30 PT. If those don't work, tell me a window that does.
4) Technical: Alex (cc) will prepare a 1-page technical appendix describing SSO/SAML flow, data residency options, and expected latency/throughput for a 1k agents pilot.

A couple of notes on procurement/contracting we typically see:
- We can accept PO + SOW for pilots.
- Standard redlines we see from enterprise counsel: data residency clause and limited liability language; we're happy to work with your procurement/legal team to get a narrow SOW for the pilot.

Related links: pricing overview and sample SOW (internal HubSpot): https://redwood.app/hubspot/record/ZE-4521
DocuSign envelope for T&Cs (placeholder): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345

If helpful I can also include a short ROI slide for Clara showing the projected 30% AHT reduction and estimated cost savings vs headcount.

Best,
